_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or derived from extracted values by a rule stated beside it.

pilots.basis: pilot projects UT REAL Health AI announced funding for

submissions.basis: systemwide submissions the pilots were chosen from

award_total_millions.basis: award total in millions of dollars, more than

institutions.basis: UT institutions the awards span, as the page counts them

moonshot_cap.basis: dollars each moonshot project received, up to

hospital_sites.basis: UT hospital sites the emergency triage assistant runs across

trauma_cases.basis: trauma cases the assistant was trained on, more than

fetal_accuracy_pct.basis: the accuracy the page gives the fetal movement app, percent

noshow_appointments.basis: appointments the no-show project says it saved at UTHealth Houston, more than

noshow_revenue.basis: revenue in dollars the no-show project says it saved at UTHealth Houston

san_antonio_low.basis: appointments a year the page projects at UT Health San Antonio, the low end

notes_records_millions.basis: patient records in millions the suicide risk pilot will read, more than

prescreen_patients.basis: patients the trial prescreening platform was validated on, nearly

sim_encounters.basis: simulation encounters the grading platform has supported, more than

epic_tools.basis: Epic tools the Dell Medical School pilot implements

submissions_per_pilot.rule: submissions // pilots, exact because 120 divides by 12

unfunded_submissions.basis: submissions that were not among the funded pilots

pilots_without_savings_figure.basis: funded pilots for which the page states no saved count: every pilot but the no-show project, the one whose entry states what it saved

noshow_san_antonio_ratio_floor.basis: how many times the San Antonio projection's low end is the Houston count, to one decimal
noshow_san_antonio_ratio_floor.rule: san_antonio_low / noshow_appointments, rounded half up to one decimal

seat_unit.basis: appointments one drawn seat stands for on the waiting room frame
seat_unit.rule: the largest of 100, 250, 500 and 1000 that divides both noshow_appointments and san_antonio_low exactly

noshow_seats.basis: occupied seats drawn for the project's own Houston count

sa_seats.basis: empty seats drawn for San Antonio's projected low end

bays_per_floor.basis: lit bays drawn on each of the hospital's ten floors, one bay per submission
bays_per_floor.rule: submissions // 10, the kit hospital's floor count, exact

pilots_with_savings_figure.basis: funded pilots whose entry states what it saved
